articles.title: The Coinbase allegations expose Bitcoin's corporate governance gap
articles.snippet: Corporate adoption of bitcoin will stall as long as companies can't show who controls the money, who approves its movement, or whether it's still there, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

articles.title: Equity weakness could damp demand for bitcoin after biggest ETF inflows in a month
Bitcoin drops to $81,400 as Asian chip stocks tumble, options traders seek downside protection
articles.snippet: Bitcoin slipped 0.5% to around $81,400 even after the biggest daily spot ETF inflow in nearly a month as South Korea's Kospi index fell 3.7% on AI worries.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs just saw their biggest day in a month thanks entirely to BlackRock
articles.snippet: Fidelity's FBTC and Grayscale's GBTC saw outflows of $83.6 million and $54.9 million, respectively.

articles.title: Lloyds and Barclays among UK banks named in crypto transfer complaints, advocacy group says
articles.snippet: UK banks are facing scrutiny over crypto transfer limits and bans as Stand With Crypto reports thousands of complaints ahead of the country’s 2027 regulatory regime.
